actual_stopping_semantics.interpretation: Reached the full200epoch budget; patience10 was not exhausted (last best at199). Exported checkpoint identity is the saved best-validation checkpoint under the pinned source, not the final last_checkpoint.pt. No convergence claim.

freeze_timing_evidence.interpretation: Pinned driver/fit CLI ordering plus recorded command starts and current report mtimes agree with settings frozen before confirmation. Filesystem times are not independent tamper-proof timestamps.

limits: Best/last checkpoint bytes were hashed, not deserialized; native best-checkpoint restoration is supported by pinned source/history, not independently inspected model weights.
Post-transform training/validation matrix digests match the frozen cached baseline records; transformed counts were not regenerated or decoded.
Observed-to-export ID order was checked against frozen cached baseline public exports, with training IDs also matching the train-only gene manifest; H5AD count/observation arrays were not decoded.

State labels, biological transport costs, ridge probes and neighborhood/hubness diagnostics were not independently rerun. The run completed the full 200-epoch budget without early stopping, retaining best-validation epoch199; this does not establish convergence or biological/causal correctness.
This single audited integration seed reuses frozen biological cells and does not create another independent biological world.
scope: Only the completed seed 0 scMRDR baseline confirmation fit, fixed cached baseline references, and completed informative GLUE report metadata. JSON/public train-val-discovery NPZ reads (including model-specific latent arrays), public H5AD/checkpoint byte hashes, source/version reads. No counts decoded, truth NPZ/private/protected biological cohort arrays, active scMRDR seed 1 or any other new partial output reads, checkpoint/model deserialization, CUDA, fits, causal evaluation or state/probe scoring reruns. Public ID sampling and arithmetic on recorded native losses/embedded report aggregates only.
